text:
maria-partnerships: Quick kickoff  packaging checklist for AWS / GCP / Azure. Target: assets + procurement note by Fri COB. Who takes AMI / container / ARM packaging?

tom-aws: I can own AWS AMI manifest + private-offer mapping. Need product code, consolidated-billing example, and logo files. :+1:

lena-legal: I'll assemble legal bundle (DPA, SOC2 overview, export controls). Also need a list of third-party libs for license review.

rishi-product: I'll build the SKU/pricing matrix. Proposed SKUs: core, dedicated, enterprise-commit. Will push a CSV template shortly.

emma-design: I'll create marketplace hero banners (1200x628) + product card images. Upload target: /shared/marketing/marketplace-assets. Any copy notes?

ben-eng: Plan for artefacts: nightly build -> tag `marketplace-2026-03-xx`; produce one AMI per region + container image for GCR/ghcr. Need CI creds for publishing to AWS/GCP/Azure registries.

finance-bot: @rishi-product remember to include forecast bands (S/M/L) and example invoice split for procurement. They frequently ask for monthly committed vs usage breakdown.

marketplace-bot: Ticket created: /tasks/MP-842  Marketplace packaging & onboarding tracker (assignees: ben-eng, rishi-product, lena-legal).

maria-partnerships: Blockers? list them so we can triage.

ben-eng: License scan flagged GPL-2 dependency in infra-agent. I'll submit PR to replace it; ETA Tue. If not resolved, may block AMI listing for AWS.

lena-legal: If GPL component remains, we'll need legal approval and a packaging exception document. That could add 1-2 weeks.

rishi-product: I'll add `data_processing_location`, `requires_baa`, `support_sla` and `procurement_instructions` columns to the CSV. Also note variants (hosted / dedicated / private).

emma-design: Copy note: keep description concise (<= 300 chars) and include a short architecture card that fits marketplace constraints.

tom-aws: For procurement docs, include a step-by-step "How to procure" with consolidated-billing screenshots and the product-code mapping. Procurement teams love examples.

finance-bot: Also include a sample PO workflow and contact for invoicing (billing@redwood.ai).

marketplace-bot: Reminder: For Azure Managed Apps, include ARM template + parameterized deployment guide. GCP wants container + Deployment Manager or Terraform snippet.

maria-partnerships: Owners confirmed: artefacts = ben-eng; SKU/pricing = rishi-product; legal = lena-legal; design = emma-design; AWS procurement note = tom-aws + finance-bot. Deliverables: CSV, legal checklist PDF, AMI/container/ARM artifact list, listing images, procurement.md by Fri COB.

ben-eng: CI will run license scan tonight; I'll post results. Will try to upload initial AMI tags by Wed.

lena-legal: I'll start the checklist and flag any missing compliance docs.

rishi-product: CSV template posted: `sku,variant,price_tier,commit_required,data_processing_location,requires_baa,support_sla,procurement_instructions,notes`

emma-design: I'll upload first drafts to the shared folder and link here when ready.

marketplace-bot: Note: gov-cloud / sovereign listings require separate packaging and additional compliance. Create subtask if pursuing.

maria-partnerships: Noted. We'll split into a sovereign path if needed after license scan. Thanks everyone ":raised_hands:" Closing thread for now; reopen if urgent.
